finding.expected: After the AC3 code finding is resolved, run the required independent live self-host proof against the corrected candidate and preserve the exact command/output plus marker absence as review evidence. Do not modify repository code for this finding.
finding.issue: RUN-140-007 has Runtime verification evidence only: focused pytest passed (219 passed, 76 deselected), full antigravity-adapter pytest passed (295 passed), and git diff --check passed. Those results do not establish AC8. The RESULT claim for AC8 describes hook JSON/terminal behavior, but AC8 specifically requires an independent live native agy 1.2.6 --print run with --dangerously-skip-permissions and AIOS_ANTIGRAVITY_ACTIVE=1 proving a deliberately long run_command is denied before its start marker is created with stable AIOS_BACKGROUND_RISK_DENIED, marker remains absent, and output contains no root-agent idle/background-task termination/hook execution failure.
